User.title: User
User.description: User profile with personalized cloud-synced data collections including custom recipes, weekly plans, and shopping list states.

userId.description: Unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

recipeCount.description: Number of custom recipes created by the user.

checkedMap.description: Map of checked shopping list items.

customRecipes.description: Personalized recipe collection created by the user.

lastSyncedAt.description: Timestamp of the last successful cloud synchronization.

Recipe.title: Recipe
Recipe.description: Custom recipe entity stored in cloud database.

AppCatalog.title: AppCatalog
AppCatalog.description: Public shared generic database of official recipes, ingredients, and categories.

/users/{userId}.description: Root user profile document containing personalized data, collections, and cloud sync states.

/recipes/{recipeId}.description: Individual cloud recipes created by users.

/app_catalog/{catalogId}.description: Generic public cloud catalog storing shared app recipes and default ingredients.
